scope: agent initialization through final AC validation; excludes launcher and summary gather

phase_semantics.vt_exchange: neighbor V/theta exchange before the x-step (only when not cached)
phase_semantics.x_solve: local x-step incl. state bookkeeping and optional solve batching barriers
phase_semantics.solve_status: bus mode: global strict solve-status reduction = waiting for the slowest local solve; 0 in partition mode
phase_semantics.consensus_exchange: neighbor-only exchange of consensus rows; includes waiting for slower neighbors
phase_semantics.convergence: local residual/tolerance computation of the convergence check (excl. reductions and console)
phase_semantics.convergence_mpi: the two global reductions of the convergence check (MAX, SUM), incl. waiting
phase_semantics.console: rank-0 console line of the convergence check (only when log_every > 0)
phase_semantics.monitor: periodic and gate-triggered global AC validation (observation, not an ADMM step)

mpi_wall_semantics: blocking call elapsed time including waiting; not pure transfer time
byte_semantics: user buffer extents only; excludes object serialization, MPI protocol and physical network traffic
